name: Application - UI (Harmonia) - Java
description: Application With UI (Alpine.js + Harmonia SPA), Java REST APIs and DAOs
comment: The database schema (.table/.schema artefacts) is REQUIRED: it is what actually creates the physical tables (TableCreateProcessor). The client-Java layer only maps an @Entity to an existing table (JavaEntityManager registers, it does not CREATE), so without the schema a freshly-generated app has no tables and CRUD / CSVIM seeds fail. Shared parameters (tablePrefix, dataSource) are listed once: the first declaration of a name wins.
